name: Notification
description: Something one person must see, sent by an app (forge 26e-1): a mention, a review waiting, mail, an agent's question. Only its recipient reads, marks or dismisses it.

fields.name: Recipient
fields.description: The user id of the person it is for

fields.name: App
fields.description: The app that sent it, such as nexus or mail

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: What it is, such as mention, review or question

fields.name: Body
fields.description: A short excerpt, as plain text

fields.name: Link
fields.description: A workbench: link opening what it is about

fields.name: Key
fields.description: What makes it unique for its recipient (<app>:<subject>:<kind>): the same key notifies once

fields.name: Read
fields.description: Whether its recipient has seen it
